title: 现代中式茶品牌海报
author: 李岳
categories: 海报 / 传单,产品营销,极简主义,水墨 / 中国风,美食 / 饮品,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Generate a 9:16 vertical catering brand promotional flyer design.

The brand name is 'CHAGEE', the category is 'New Chinese Tea / Milk Tea', and the main product is 'Original Leaf Fresh Milk Tea'. The overall visual style is a high-end New Chinese tea brand style, integrating Oriental blue and white porcelain patterns, Song-style white space, modern commercial advertising layout, and youthful trendy tea communication.

The overall image uses off-white, rice paper white, blue and white porcelain blue, deep navy blue, and a small amount of brand red as the main color system, forming a clean, high-end, Oriental, fresh, and textured visual atmosphere. The background uses elegant Oriental ink landscapes, blue and white porcelain textures, tea tree branches, clouds, and fine paper textures as decorations; no clutter, no cheap collages.

A clear brand identification area is placed at the top left: brand name with English sub-caption, with a simple circular Oriental female portrait logo icon next to it. A brand temperament short phrase is added to the top right, such as 'Good tea as the base, creating Oriental flavor.'

A large title is placed in the upper-middle of the screen:
'Boya Juexian' (Lute broken after the friend's death - a classic allusion)
'A Cup of Good Tea'
The title uses high-end Oriental Song font / calligraphic title characters, with powerful strokes, clear and eye-catching, possessing a New Chinese tea advertising temperament. A subtitle is added below the main title:
'Original Leaf Fresh Milk Tea · Taste the Natural Fragrance'
or 'Original Leaf Tea Base · Freshly Made with Milk · Refreshing Tea Fragrance.'

The main visual product area is on the right or in the center, featuring one large and one small cup of brand-style tea products. The main cup is a takeaway paper cup with blue and white porcelain style patterns, blue and white Oriental motifs, brand identification marks, and 'CHAGEE' text. Next to it is a transparent cup of milk tea, which can be topped with nut crumbles, milk foam, or tea fragrance granules. The milk tea color is natural and smooth, the texture is fresh, the cup wall has slight condensation and highlights; the whole look is realistic, refreshing, delicious, and appetizing.

Three selling point icon modules are added next to the product in a simple linear style:
1. Original Leaf Tea Base: Selected high-mountain original leaf tea
2. Fresh Milk: Real milk without creamer
3. Made to Order: Freshly extracted good tea

A clean horizontal information card for discount conversion is set at the bottom of the screen:
The left side highlights discount information: 'Enjoy in-store discounts,' 'Save 5 Yuan.'
The middle reads: 'Scan code to receive coupons,' 'New user first order discount.'
The right side features a QR code placeholder area; the QR code area is clear but should not generate a real scannable code; use a simple QR placeholder image.

An action guidance bar is placed at the very bottom using a dark blue bar, containing three step icons:
'Nearby stores'
'Receive discount'
'Use in-store'
A button-style text is added to the right: 'Scan to order,' 'No queuing,' 'One step ahead to drink good tea.'

Information hierarchy must be clear: Brand Logo > Main Title > Product Main Visual > Selling Point Info > Discount Amount > QR Code / In-store Action. The layout should resemble a real offline promotional flyer, suitable for store distribution, Little Red Book displays, WeChat Moments, and in-store scan conversion.

The design should be high-end but not cold, commercial but not cheap, New Chinese but not old-fashioned, with a distinct Oriental feel that meets the aesthetic of young tea brands. The product must be the visual subject; cup materials, paper cup textures, milk tea liquid, ice feel, and lighting must be exquisite and realistic. Typography should be clean with white space and order; do not over-stack information.

Prohibit: garbled code, typos, strange English, multiple different brand logos, low resolution, low texture, cluttered colors, too many fonts, crowded layout, information overload, low-quality product images, unappetizing milk tea, weak brand identification, chaotic styles, cheap promotional template feel, over-decoration, QR codes stealing the spotlight, dark/dirty colors, irrelevance to New Chinese tea, or collage feel of different brands.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a full-bleed vertical cinematic motorsport poster for a Porsche 911 GTR, styled like a premium race-team advertisement.

Canvas: Portrait poster, 3:4 aspect ratio, dark black background with deep gold/yellow lighting, high contrast, glossy reflections, gritty racing atmosphere, no white border.

Main subject: A bright yellow Porsche-style GT race car dominates the lower half to lower two-thirds of the frame, shown from a low front-facing three-quarter angle, nose pointed slightly left, wide aggressive body kit, large rear wing, black wheels, front splitter, hood vents, side air intakes, visible roll cage, glowing cool-white circular LED headlights, windshield banner reading “PORSSCHE” or stylized “Porsche,” door number “911,” and small “GTR” marking near the side skirt. The car sits on a wet reflective black studio floor with strong gold reflections and puddle shine.

Background and mood: Behind the car, create a dramatic cloud of smoky golden mist rising upward, backlit like race-track fog. Place one enormous semi-transparent word “PORSCHE” across the entire upper background in dark bronze-gold block letters, partially obscured by smoke and the car. Add faint technical grid texture and subtle grunge speckles.

Layout and graphic elements: Add four thin yellow corner-bracket accents, one near each corner. At the top left, small spaced text reads “PORSCHE MOTORSPORT” with a tiny yellow square marker. At the right edge, set vertical spaced text reading “MOTORSPORT · TRACK-SPEC · CERTIFIED” with a tiny yellow dot. On the upper left, include a faint white technical blueprint side-view drawing of the race car with dimension lines.

Text content: On the left side beneath the blueprint, include exactly 5 technical spec rows with small yellow arrow markers: 1) “ENGINE / 4.0L FLAT-6”, 2) “POWER / 525 HP”, 3) “TORQUE / 465 NM”, 4) “WEIGHT / <1,250 KG”, 5) “DRIVE / RWD”. Near the bottom left, add the tagline “THE PUREST FORM.” Below it, create a bold title line: huge yellow “911” followed by metallic silver “GTR”. Under that title, include exactly 4 bottom stat blocks separated by thin yellow vertical lines: 1) “525 / POWER”, 2) “4.0L / ENGINE”, 3) “RWD / DRIVE”, 4) “TRACK / FOCUS”. At the very bottom left, add small caption text: “BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE. BORN ON THE TRACK.” At the bottom right, add the logo text “PORSCHE” with smaller “MOTORSPORT” beneath it and a thin yellow line.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic automotive photography blended with premium poster design, cinematic lighting, sharp details on the car, dramatic gold smoke, black-and-yellow racing palette, metallic typography, wet asphalt reflections, luxury motorsport branding, high-resolution print quality.

Constraints: Keep the composition vertically centered and poster-like; use exactly 5 left-side spec rows and exactly 4 bottom stat blocks; avoid extra cars, people, sponsor clutter, or unrelated logos; make all visible text crisp and legible where possible.\

Character design: Draw a young adult woman with very long pale silver-blue hair, blue eyes, fair skin, a calm expression, and refined secretary-like elegance. She wears a white beret with navy ribbon and blue rose ornament, a white lace capelet over puff-sleeve blouse, navy bow tie with a large blue gemstone brooch, fitted white bodice with gold buttons and chain accents, long white layered skirt with pale blue floral embroidery near the hem, dark navy underskirt ruffle, white gloves or soft sleeves, white heeled shoes, and an ID card hanging at the waist. Keep proportions consistent, elegant pose, arms relaxed. Back view must show long flowing hair, beret, navy bow and rose decoration at the lower back, and layered skirt construction.

Right portrait: Add one large framed upper-body portrait in the upper-right panel. The character holds one hand near her collar, showing the beret, hair ornament, lace capelet, bow, gemstone brooch, blouse buttons, and long hair.

Detail section: Label it “DETAIL”. Include readable Japanese-style text blocks for stats such as species AI, role secretary, age young adult appearance, height 166 cm, body type slender, personality gentle and calm, strengths organizing information and scheduling, weaknesses mechanical body and humor.
